statements.status_notes: The fixed release is maplibre-gl 6.4.1, but the customImportMapDashboards plugin imports maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-csp paths that are incompatible with maplibre-gl 6.x without upstream plugin changes. Waiting for opensearch-project/dashboards-maps to adopt a compatible maplibre-gl release.
